spells.name: Cure Light Wounds
spells.description: Heals 1d6+1 (2-7) points of damage when the cleric touches the individual. May also cure paralysis. Cannot increase hp above normal max.

spells.name: Detect Evil
spells.description: Detects evil intentions or evilly enchanted objects within 120', causing them to glow.

spells.name: Charm Person
spells.description: One humanoid creature must save vs. Spells or be charmed, treating the caster as a friend.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.description: Creates 1 glowing arrow that does 1d6+1 (2-7) damage. Auto-hits. +1 missile per 5 caster levels.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.description: Puts 2d8 HD of creatures to sleep (max 4+1 HD each). Undead immune. Lower HD affected first.

spells.name: Bless
spells.description: Raises morale +1, gives +1 to hit and damage for all friendly creatures in range. Must be cast before battle.

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.description: Single target saves at -2 or paralyzed. Group: 1d4 targets affected.

spells.name: Fire Ball
spells.description: Missile explodes into 40' diameter ball. 1d6 damage per caster level. Save for half damage.

spells.name: Fly
spells.description: Caster or touched person can fly up to 120'/round in any direction.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.description: Removes spell effects in 20'x20'x20' area. 5% failure chance per level difference if caster is lower level.
